title: Range Filter Chain: abstract interface + unique_ptr
hints: Each derived class overrides both `apply` and `name`. Mark them `override` and `const`.
MovingAverage: keep a running sum; add in[i], and once i >= window subtract in[i - window]. Divide by min(i+1, window).
FilterChain stores `std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Filter>>`; `add` must `std::move` the pointer in.
Chain apply: `auto out = in; for (const auto& f : filters_) out = f->apply(out); return out;`
